cs.t: > I'd prefer a "low-end" workstation with 32GB memory, but because of the price point I can only afford a 16GB non-workstation one. I don't do gaming any more but I still prefer a good integrated video card. I started buying 4x4 mini PCs.  They're exactly what you describe.  For $600 I got an 8 core AMD Ryzen 7 8745H with 96GB of RAM from Minisforum.  The graphics aren't half bad and the overall system has been really good.  It's even got better thermal performance than the Intel 4x4 I had previously and generally runs 10C cooler for the same workloads. If you don't absolutely need a "backpack portable" computer I can only highly recommend them.
